subject: Request to move demo — Friday executive offsite clash
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@stackbridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Request to move demo — Friday executive offsite clash

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Quick note — our exec team just confirmed an offsite that conflicts with the 3pm PT demo on Friday (we didn't realize the new date would land on the offsite day). We still want the walkthrough this week if possible, but need to either move the meeting earlier on Friday or shift to Monday.

Attendees who must be there: Tom Liu (PM), Elena Park (Head of Ops). Tom may only be available in the morning PT.

Are there alternative slots that work on your side? If not, Monday morning would be my fallback. Appreciate the quick help.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Operations, StackBridge
elena@stackbridge.io

[Attachment: org-offsite-agenda.pdf (stub)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — Friday executive offsite clash

Marissa — looping you and Soojin to triage. SE coverage is tight this week: Soojin is traveling Wed–Fri (APAC travel), but can cover a morning PT slot on Friday before flights if needed.

Options I can offer quickly:
- Friday 9:00–10:00 PT (Soojin can present a condensed 45-min walkthrough + Q&A)
- Friday 11:00–12:00 PT (SE overlap okay but tight; would need Marissa to moderate)
- Monday 10:00–11:00 PT (full session, ideal if they need broad coverage)

Marissa, if you can share a preferred primary/backup slot I will check with Elena and send a calendar update. Also attaching the latest mutual action plan for reference.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@stackbridge.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — Friday executive offsite clash

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up. We can absolutely be flexible. Connor, thanks for the slots.

Elena — quick ask: can Tom do Friday morning at 9am PT? If so, Soojin will run a compact agenda that focuses on latency/cost controls and rollout options for your infra team (we'll hold advanced troubleshooting for the full session Monday if you prefer). If 9am doesn't work, Monday 10am PT is totally fine.

Proposed compact agenda for 9am (45–60 min):
- 0–10m: intros & goals (Elena, Tom)
- 10–30m: live demo: hosted vs. dedicated deployment scenarios (Soojin)
- 30–45m: performance & cost levers + Q&A (Soojin + Connor)
- 45–60m: next steps / confirm mutual action plan (Marissa)

If you confirm 9am, I'll send an updated invite and add the short MAP as an attachment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer (Sales Ops), Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Park <elena@stackbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — Friday executive offsite clash

Sounds good — Tom confirmed he can do Friday 9:00am PT. We also want to add our CTO (Michael Han) for the first 20 minutes; he is in PST and will join remotely. One small ask: could you focus on the Dedicated vs Private deployment comparisons (security knobs and routing) in the first 15 minutes — Michael will want to understand data isolation options quickly.

Please send the updated invite. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Elena

Quick logistics:
- I'll present from my laptop (VPN) before heading to the airport, so please keep the session to the condensed agenda if possible.
- Connor/Marissa: please add the customer’s CTO (michael.han@stackbridge.io) to the invite and flag in the description: “15m security deep-dive at start.”

I've attached the updated calendar invite stub and included the MAP that Marissa referenced. See you Friday 9am PT.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
